description: Turn ready-made rule names (see fusebox_rules) and limits into a link that opens Fusebox's wallet setup with those fuses switched on and filled in. The owner opens it, connects their wallet and signs; nothing is sent from here. Rules that aren't live fuses yet come back with their Studio link instead.

approvals_above.description: Two of three: payments above this need two approvers, USDT0 (default 20)

cap.description: Daily budget: the most per UTC day, USDT0 (default 50)

cooling_off_hours.description: Payee book: hours before a new payee gets full payments (default 24)

repeat_window_hours.description: No double payments: hours the same payment is remembered (default 24)

trial_amount.description: Payee book: the most a payee still cooling off can get, USDT0 (default 2)

name: fusebox_setup_link
title: Make a wallet setup link from ready-made rules
